'''LaserHone''' was a company that manufactured various models of knives and bladed [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]. Their models were attractive because they vibrated at ultrasonic frequencies, and thus, unlike many vibroweapons, were inaudible to many species.
